Starts blank, plus import and export improvements.

### What's changed
- **Starts blank.** A new install has no card templates, clients or sample data, ready for your own. Everything works before your first template exists: you can add clients and people, and import from CSV, then design the card when you're ready.
- **CSV import.** For a client without a template, the blank CSV includes every column. A row that names a photo file you didn't choose is shown as not importable, so nobody gets a card with a missing photo. A list exported from the program imports straight back.
- **Exports keep their names.** Downloaded files keep macrons and other letters from client names, instead of dropping them.
- **Settings > Print a test card** prints a plain test pattern when there are no templates yet.
- Tidier empty screens.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.2 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.2.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
